parameters.name: FirewallSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the NAT firewall. Valid values:

*   **open**: enabled
*   **close**: disabled

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: NatRouteEntryList
parameters.description: The routes to be switched to the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: ProxyName
parameters.description: The name of the NAT firewall. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). However, it cannot start with an underscore.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description:
The region ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

>  For more information about Cloud Firewall supported regions, see [Supported regions](~~195657~~).

parameters.name: StrictMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the strict mode. Valid values:

*   1: yes
*   0: no

parameters.name: VswitchAuto
parameters.description:
The mode of the vSwitch that you want to use. Valid values:

*   **true**: automatic
*   **false**: manual

parameters.name: VswitchCidr
parameters.description: The CIDR block of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is required if you set the VswitchAuto parameter to true.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw create-security-proxy --lang zh --proxy-name nat-firewall --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000 --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp1okz6k7000000 --vswitch-auto true --vswitch-id vsw-bp1sqg9w000000 --nat-route-entry-list NextHopType=NatGateway RouteTableId=vtb-2ze1000000 NextHopId=ngw-bp1okz6000000 DestinationCidr=0.0.0.0/0 --firewall-switch close --strict-mode 0 --vswitch-cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --fw-vswitch-zone-id cn-beijing-b --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw CreateSecurityProxy --region cn-hangzhou --NatRouteEntryList.1.RouteTableId 'vtb-2ze1000000' --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --VswitchAuto true --NatRouteEntryList.1.NextHopId 'ngw-bp1okz6000000' --VswitchCidr '0.0.0.0/0' --Lang zh --NatRouteEntryList.1.DestinationCidr '0.0.0.0/0' --VswitchId 'vsw-bp1sqg9w000000' --NatRouteEntryList.1.NextHopType NatGateway --StrictMode 0 --VpcId 'vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000' --ProxyName 'nat-firewall' --FwVswitchZoneId 'cn-beijing-b' --NatGatewayId 'ngw-bp1okz6k7000000' --FirewallSwitch close
